name: Corsa PRO Control TLR

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store pages do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Corsa PRO race tire with a tougher build for rough roads, cobbles and wet race days.
pressure_note: The store page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Vittoria says it adds grip on rain-slicked tarmac for rough race days.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store in euros and by a Vittoria Tmall store in mainland China; the US store did not load on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

price_observations.market: Vittoria Tmall store (vittoria运动户外旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 467.

caveats: Measured wet grip (73) was close to the regular Corsa PRO (74) despite the wet-weather positioning.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.

image.shown: Tan-wall Corsa PRO Control TLR render from Vittoria's product page; the file name labels it as the 38-42 mm version.
